summary: Define typed capture contracts and synthetic fixtures
description: Prerequisites: none. Define immutable value objects, ports, typed outcomes, redaction rules, and synthetic example.invalid fixtures for the one-message capture core; no live adapters.
acceptance: Domain types cover selected mail, task draft, request identity, delivery outcome, and redacted error states without message bodies or credentials.
Synthetic fixtures use only fabricated example.invalid identities and validate untrusted text boundaries.
